d: Spiky, short-cropped deep purple hair frames a youthful, smug face with narrow, glowing violet eyes. The slender, athletic build is dressed in a dark purple and black ensemble consisting of a high-collared tunic, tight trousers, and calf-high boots, all accented with white trim and gold metallic ornaments. A long, flowing dark purple cape with a light-colored interior is draped over the shoulders, held by a gold chain and a glowing yellow gem. A gold ornate belt with a Roman numeral "IX" buckle sits at the waist, and a single small gold hoop earring is visible on the right ear.
